古观庭院，煞气翻涌。

四象锁煞阵被破，百具式神失去阵力加持，再也无法结成联动战阵，虽依旧悍不畏死往前冲杀，却已是强弩之末。

在小队雷法、石术、暗器、蛊术、符箓的联手清剿下，成片式神被雷光焚灭、被石矛碾碎、被暗器封脉、被蛊光净化，化作缕缕黑烟消散在空气里。

庭院之内，黑影越来越少，阴冷凶煞之气飞速退散。

不多时，近百式神被清扫殆尽，古观庭院终于恢复空旷，只剩满地破碎的符咒残渣、崩坏的枯骨碎片，以及缭绕未散的淡淡黑气。

战场尘埃落定，只剩石坛之前，两大高手对峙。

渡边苍玄周身灰白狩衣无风自动，黑气缠绕周身，阴邪咒力层层叠加，眼眶泛着暗紫煞气，整个人气场暴涨，如同深渊恶鬼降临，压得周遭空气都冰冷凝滞。

他身为东瀛阴阳寮老牌大咒师，修为精深，精通镇魂、式神、阴阵、献祭多重诡术，之前一直倚仗阵法与式神御敌，未曾全力出手，此刻式神尽灭、阵基被破，终于放下所有依仗，准备亲身搏杀。

范梦雪立于对面，周身雷光萦绕，银白雷芒熠熠生辉，神霄雷道灵气蓄势待发，丝毫不惧对方暴涨的威压。

胡九郎缓步走到范梦雪身侧，黑衣静立，神色淡漠清冷，周身道韵内敛却厚重，龙虎山正统道术底蕴铺开，与渡边苍玄的阴邪咒力隔空对峙。

一人道门道宗，一人阴阳大咒师，正邪两道，气场碰撞，古观之内风起云涌。

“中土道门后辈，能逼到本座亲自出手，你们足以引以为傲。”渡边苍玄语气阴冷，“可惜，傲气不能保命。今日便让你们见识，东瀛阴阳寮真正的咒道之力。”

话音落下，他双手快速结印，口中诵念古老晦涩的献祭咒文。

咒音低沉诡异，盘旋古观上空，地面裂痕蔓延，无数漆黑阴气从地底涌出，汇聚成数道鬼首虚影，漂浮半空，眼窝赤红，张口发出无声嘶吼，带着吞噬生魂的凶煞。

同时他袖袍一挥，飞出五枚漆黑咒玉，凌空排布，结成五方镇魂咒阵，笼罩整片古观上空，锁住四方空间，隔绝退路，也压制外人灵气驰援。

“困阵、祭鬼、咒力叠加，不愧是大咒师。”林佳在后方冷静分析，“他想以阵法困住我们所有人，再以祭鬼逐个吞噬耗损，最后再亲手斩杀主力。”

“想得太美。”胡九郎眸光平静，“旁门左道的邪咒诡术，在正统道门面前，终究上不得台面。”

他抬手凌空画符，指尖金光流转，虚空浮现先天八卦纹路，缓缓铺开，与上空五方镇魂咒阵隔空抗衡。

八卦道纹光明中正，生生不息；镇魂咒阵阴邪诡秘，噬魂吞气。

一正一邪，两道大阵在古观半空僵持对峙，气场震荡，狂风卷着碎石在庭院盘旋飞舞。

范梦雪不再等待，率先出手。

“神霄天雷，斩邪灭咒！”

Chapter 90: The spell master fights the Tao, and the ancient view determines the outcome - "749 Game of the Taoist Priest Descending the Mountain"

In the ancient courtyard, evil spirits surged.

The Four Symbols Locking Formation was broken, and the hundred shikigami lost the power of the formation, and could no longer form a coordinated battle formation. Although they still charged forward without fear of death, they were at the end of their strength.

Under the joint efforts of the team of lightning magic, stone magic, hidden weapons, Gu magic, and talismans, the pieces of shikigami were burned by lightning, crushed by stone spears, sealed by hidden weapons, and purified by Gu light, turning into wisps of black smoke and dissipating in the air.

In the courtyard, there were fewer and fewer dark shadows, and the cold and sinister aura quickly dissipated.

Not long after, nearly a hundred shikigami were swept away, and the Guguan courtyard was finally empty again, leaving only broken talisman residues, broken bone fragments, and lingering faint black air all over the ground.

The dust on the battlefield has settled, leaving only the stone altar where the two masters faced each other.

Watanabe Cangxuan's gray and white hunting clothes were windless, black energy wrapped around his body, and the evil spells were superimposed layer by layer. His eyes were filled with dark purple evil energy, and his whole aura skyrocketed, like an evil spirit coming from the abyss, making the surrounding air cold and stagnant.

As a veteran great spell master of Japan's Yin Yang Liao, he has profound cultivation and is proficient in multiple tricks such as soul-suppressing, shikigami, Yin formations, and sacrifices. Before, he had always relied on formations and shikigami to defend against the enemy, but he had never used his full strength. At this moment, the shikigami were wiped out and the foundation of the formation was broken. He finally put down all the reliance and prepared to fight personally.

Fan Mengxue stood on the opposite side, with lightning lingering all over his body, the silvery white lightning shining brightly, and the thunder energy of Shenxiao ready to go out, not afraid of the opponent's surge in pressure.

Hu Jiulang walked slowly to Fan Mengxue's side, standing quietly in black clothes, with an indifferent and cold expression. The Taoist charm around him was restrained but thick, and the orthodox Taoist foundation of Longhu Mountain was spread out, confronting Watanabe Cangxuan's evil spell in the air.

One person is a Taoist sect, and the other is a great yin-yang spell master. The two paths of good and evil collide with each other, creating a turmoil in the ancient temple.

"You, the juniors of the Middle Earth Dao Sect, can force me to take action personally. You are proud of me." Watanabe Cangxuan said in a cold tone, "Unfortunately, pride cannot protect your life. Today I will let you see the true power of the curse of the Yin Yang Lao in Japan."

After he finished speaking, he quickly formed seals with his hands and recited ancient and obscure sacrificial incantations.

The sound of the curse was low and strange, hovering over the ancient temple, cracks in the ground spread, and countless dark yin energy gushes out from the ground, converging into several ghost-headed shadows, floating in the air, with red eye sockets, and a silent roar from the mouth, with the evil spirit of devouring living souls.

At the same time, he waved his sleeves and flew out five jet-black cursed jades. They were arranged in the air to form a five-way soul-suppressing curse array, covering the entire ancient temple, locking the four directions, blocking the retreat, and suppressing the spiritual energy of outsiders rushing to help.

"The trapping formation, ghost sacrifice, and superimposed spell power make him worthy of being a great spell master." Lin Jia analyzed calmly from behind. "He wants to trap us all with the formation, then use the ghost sacrifice to devour and consume us one by one, and finally kill the main force with his own hands."

"It's such a beautiful thought." Hu Jiulang's eyes were calm, "The evil spells and tricks of the side sects will never be able to be put on the stage in front of the orthodox Taoist sect."

He raised his hand to draw a talisman in the air, golden light flowed from his fingertips, and innate Bagua lines appeared in the void, slowly spreading out to compete with the five-way soul-suppressing spell array above.

The Eight Diagrams Taoist Patterns are bright and righteous, and endless; the Soul-Calming Curse Formation is sinister and mysterious, devouring souls and qi.

One good and one evil, the two formations were in a stalemate in the sky of the ancient temple. The aura was shaking, and the strong wind was carrying gravel circling and flying in the courtyard.

Fan Mengxue no longer waited and took the lead.

"Thunder from the sky, evil-killing curse!"
